featured_reviews.name: aditi mandloi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Disappointing Experience – Poor Facilities and Unresponsive Management
I stayed at The Bombay Home Company for a week, and unfortunately, it was one of the most frustrating hospitality experiences I’ve had.
For the first four days, the air conditioning and jet spray in the bathroom were not functioning — a serious issue given the sweltering summer heat in Mumbai. Despite repeated complaints, the issue remained unresolved. An electrician was sent, but the AC continued to malfunction, leaving me to sleep in an uncomfortably hot room night after night.
After several follow-ups, I was finally offered an alternative accommodation — but it was located 10 kilometers away. No shuttle or assistance was provided for the move, and I had to arrange and pay for transport myself. Upon arrival, I was shocked to find that the new place was not a proper Airbnb apartment, but rather a private room that had been hastily vacated for my stay.
The room reeked of cigarette smoke despite being advertised as non-smoking — a serious concern for someone like me with a smoke allergy. The toilet was unhygienic, the space was extremely cramped, and to make matters worse, the geyser didn’t work. When I reported this, I was told someone would come to fix it, but no one showed up even after an hour.
At that point, I decided to vacate the property and requested a refund for the remaining three days. Not only was my request denied, but the management also stopped responding altogether. When I pointed out that the amenities they failed to provide — working AC, geyser, clean and smoke-free room — were not in line with what was promised, they simply said it was “not in their policy” to offer refunds.
The overall experience was deeply disappointing — from the lack of basic amenities to the unprofessional and indifferent attitude of the staff. I would not recommend this place to anyone looking for a comfortable or reliable stay in Mumbai.

Also their sofa had a hole and nail in it which was not visible and i got hurt by that.

featured_reviews.name: Janie Joy
featured_reviews.review_text:
Title: Exceptional Stay at Omkar Vive, Mumbai!

We recently had the pleasure of staying at Omkar Vive in Mumbai, and we were thoroughly impressed with our apartment accommodation. From the moment we arrived, we felt at home, thanks to the thoughtful amenities and services provided.

The apartment was fully equipped with everything we needed, from essentials like shampoo and dishwasher liquid to luxuries like coffee and a washing machine. The AC and fans kept us cool, and the big fans and ac dried our clothes quickly – a huge plus for us!

As a couple unfamiliar with the country, we appreciated the exceptional service offered by Omkar Vive. The complimentary cleaning services were a great touch, and the privacy we received was top-notch. The security cameras added an extra layer of safety, making us feel secure and at ease.

We were also impressed with the convenience of the delivery services, which brought everything right to our doorstep. The taxi services were equally convenient, with pickups and drop-offs right outside our apartment's main door – a huge relief on rainy days or when we didn't want to wait around in the open.

Overall, we highly recommend Omkar Vive for its outstanding services, affordability, and cleanliness. The staff were friendly and helpful, and the property was well-maintained. We felt like we were in good hands, and we can't wait to stay there again.

G and J from New Zealand 🇳🇿
